hypothesis.primary: A bounded ATR-aware no-trade state can preserve the frozen lattice-consensus signal while reducing position-size changes that are small relative to the contest ATR-linked transaction-cost scale.
hypothesis.expected_failure_mode: The no-trade band suppresses useful reallocations or simply reproduces the same economics after weekly re-anchoring.
hypothesis.cost_hypothesis: Average turnover should fall versus the exact base-lattice control, with graceful Sharpe retention across the 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost ladder.

controls.base_lattice: Remove the recursive execution guard entirely while preserving the signal family.
controls.fixed_deadband: Replace the asset-specific ATR threshold with a fixed 2.5 percentage-point weight threshold, destroying the proposed ATR-cost pairing.
controls.hysteresis_atr: Diagnostic only: add a 3/5 retention threshold. Synthetic mechanics indicated this can increase turnover, so it is explicitly not the central candidate and cannot be selected after economic observation.

pre_economic_mechanics.note: These are mechanics checks only, not market-performance evidence.
